insurer_name.value: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited

nine_month_waiting_period.value: 36 months waiting period under Maternity Cover

baby_day_one_cover.value: Covered up to the Base Sum Insured (under optional cover Baby Cover from Day 1)

thirty_day_waiting_period.value: 30 days (except claims arising due to an Accident)

day_care_expenses.value: Covered for Medical Expenses on Hospitalization of Insured Person in Hospital or Day Care Centre for Day Care Treatment

opd_benefit.value: Excluded by default under Section C.III.xiii (Covered under optional OPD Cover up to limits specified in Schedule of Coverage)

domiciliary_hospitalization.value: Covered for Medical Expenses incurred on Domiciliary Hospitalization prescribed by treating Medical Practitioner

annual_health_checkup.value: Covered under optional cover Preventive Health Check Up up to the limit mentioned on the Schedule of Coverage

bariatric_treatment.value: Excluded (Obesity/Weight control) unless fulfilling specific medical criteria (advice of doctor, supported by clinical protocols, age 18+, BMI >= 40 or >= 35 with severe co-morbidities)

ayush_treatment.value: Covered by default for In-patient care expenses up to Sum Insured of Section B.I (Hospitalization Expenses) in an AYUSH Hospital for Ayurvedic, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy, Yoga & Naturopathy

lgbtq_coverage.value: Excluded (Change-of-Gender treatments: Expenses related to any treatment, including surgical management, to change characteristics of the body to those of the opposite sex are excluded)

organ_donor_expenses.value: Covered towards organ donor's Hospitalization for harvesting of the donated organ where Insured Person is the recipient (Donor Pre- and Post-Hospitalization are excluded)

infertility_treatment.value: Excluded by default under Section C.II.xiv (Covered under optional Infertility Cover up to the limit mentioned in Schedule of Coverage)

surrogacy.value: Excluded (Gestational Surrogacy / surrogate or vicarious pregnancy)

ambulance_charges.value: Covered for expenses incurred on Road Ambulance Services for emergency transfer to nearest Hospital, hospital to hospital, or hospital to home within same city

corporate_buffer_limit.value: Available as optional cover up to limits and terms specified in Policy Schedule/Certificate of Insurance

disease_wise_capping.value: Available as optional cover: Claims for specified Illnesses will be admissible up to maximum of Sub-limits mentioned in Schedule of Coverage

waiver_conditions.value: Optional modifications available to waive/modify: 30-day General Waiting Period (Section B.II.3), Specific Illness Waiting Period (Section B.II.2), and Pre-Existing Disease Waiting Period (Section B.II.1) as specified in Schedule of Coverage
